data.name: Nakiyah
data.gender_notes: Nakiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, the name Nakiyah means 'she who provides comfort and solace'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'nakaha' which means 'to console'. In Islamic history, it is the name of a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who provided comfort and support to the Muslims during times of hardship. The name Nakiyah carries the meaning “Comforter, Solace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nakiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody comforter, solace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nakiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comforter, Solace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nakiyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
